dedupe_keys.name: resonant wireless power transfer prototype frequency control tests

description: This deposit contains laboratory measurements from a resonant wireless-power-transfer prototype at Universidad Tecnológica de Panamá. The researchers vary vertical antenna misalignment and load while a proportional–integral controller adjusts frequency using measured voltage–current phase shift. Logged signals include frequency, phase shift, load voltage and supply current, acquired through a LabVIEW interface and processed with MATLAB. Mendeley version 3 provides one ZIP archive free under MIT. Enclosed file formats and exact collection dates were not established from the inspected inventory. Coverage is a laboratory prototype, and its power scale and tested arrangements limit inference for vehicle charging installations. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating power-transfer and frequency-control components in charging-system simulations. model-system-advisor-model-sam is a related energy modelling resource, without a verified wireless-transfer component. No archive, controller algorithm or laboratory device was downloaded or operated.
